question: MLB: Will the New York Mets sweep the Miami Marlins OR will the 3-game series total 24 or more runs?
textDescription:
See previous similar propositions. 

Resolution criteria

This market will resolve to YES if either of the following conditions is met for the 3-game regular season series between the New York Mets and the Miami Marlins scheduled for September 7–9, 2026:

Mets Sweep: The New York Mets win all three games of the series.

High-Scoring Series: The total combined runs scored by both teams across all three games in the series is 24 or more (i.e., Game 1 runs + Game 2 runs + Game 3 runs $\ge$ 24).

If neither of these conditions is met, the market will resolve to NO.

Postponements and Edge Cases:

All games must be completed on or before September 10, 2026 (accounting for potential doubleheaders or makeups of postponed games from the series) to count toward the "sweep" or "24 runs" totals.

If any scheduled game is postponed beyond September 10, 2026, or canceled:

The market will resolve to YES if the cumulative total runs from the completed games of the series is already 24 or more.

If the cumulative total runs from the completed games is under 24 and the series is not fully completed by September 10, 2026, the market will resolve to NO (as a sweep is not achieved and the run threshold was not reached).
